pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. PLY08 finished under 41.5 because HOME led early, called PLY04 clock runs (he already has 59 carries in three games), and the unlisted PLY14 role at a 53.5 price soaked the middle targets AWAY was supposed to bleed, leaving PLY08 at 3 targets and about 28 yards on the perimeter where AWAY allows under 6.8 YPA. PLY15 went over 89.5 because AWAY stayed in the game or led, he got 22+ carries, and one of HOME's frequent 10+ runs (18 allowed in 6 games) was his, with a dump-off on top. That counter-case is real but not stronger than the base read while PLY14's status is unknown and his own L3 rate is 76.3, so both stay leans rather than drops.
